classificationDefinitions.present: Canonical field contains a usable value.
classificationDefinitions.not_applicable: Schema applicability excludes this vessel category.
classificationDefinitions.researched_unknown: Field was researched and remains unsupported/unknown; keep candidate eligible.
classificationDefinitions.variable_by_configuration: A single model-wide value would be misleading because production/configuration varies.
classificationDefinitions.normalization_gap: Equivalent/source-backed value already exists in boatmodels.json under a legacy/source field and should be normalized, not re-researched.
classificationDefinitions.systemic_program_gap: Field is registered but unpopulated fleet-wide; treat as a field-program/schema adoption task, not hundreds of model failures.
classificationDefinitions.missing_research: Applicable field lacks a canonical value and no evidence marks it intentionally unknown/variable.
